item.title: BF font in existing logo
item.description: I’ve been asked to recreate a logo and I can’t place the face…I know the “script” is Caflisch Script Web Pro and I thought the boldface was a Futura or Frutiger, but the G isn’t consistent with Futura and the S and C isn’t correct with Frutiger, but close. I can tell from the weight at the bottom of the U that it has been manually “scrunched” but need to nail the ID and no one else knows. So, I come to those more knowledgeable than I. Any help would be appreciated.
